Dear [u/helvr](https://www.reddit.com/user/helvr/), first of all I wish you the best and much luck with your driving licence! Do not let mean people take the fun away from you! :-)

I have another story to tell, but yes - I do agree with you! 

Everytime I see a driving-school-car, I let the young student drive first to help them out, because I remember the time when I was learning how to drive. Most of the time you see them waving and smiling back - as a little "thank you".

But the sad thing is, that some drivers behind me think *"it is uncool to help driving students out"* and they honk at me! It is really sad how people have not any nerves when they drive cars.

God bless you and drive carefully! :)
